correctness.rationale: Coordinate swapping pairs the quadrant walks from the two roots through length m−2 without any truncation. Their near-side defects cancel, while the only far-side contribution at length m−2 is the unique straight walk from u to the opposite short side, interpreted as the empty walk when m=2. Therefore the difference of the defect moments is exactly +1 at that length and zero earlier. Round k+1 determines the length-k defect moment from the recursion of neighbour colours. The fixed-graph unary C² rank correspondence holds: to count neighbours and non-neighbours of lower-rank unary types one uses the previous colours, adjacency/equality and the global type totals. This proves the first split, rank and stabilization bound. An independent script at /workspace/audit-evidence/5/grid.py checked all 210 pairs 2≤m<n≤22, not just the 204 cases in the attached script (whose outer loop stops at m=18). That limited coverage does not affect the proof.
